# StealthVox

> StealthVox is an AI speaking app (Android, Google Play) that turns the conversations you actually have into language study material. You can speak in your native language; the AI rewrites what you said as natural sentences in the language you are learning, then you practice them out loud. Supports 12 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Russian, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch.

## Features
- Circle Talk: chat with a group of AI friends about topics you like
- Scenario Talk: rehearse real situations (airport check-in, ordering food)
- Duo direct call: call a friend; afterwards the conversation becomes study material
- Duo interpreted call: talk with a friend who speaks another language, each in your own language, with AI interpretation
- Alternative expressions: compare standard, American, British and native-speaker phrasing
- Instant tutoring: say a new sentence with the same grammar, get corrections and explanations in your language
- ESSAY: the conversation rewritten as one native-sounding text
- PRACTICE: swap roles and replay the conversation
- Shadowing and Snap Echoing: hear your own story in a native voice and repeat after it
- Keepers: save favorite sentences

## Good fit for
- Learners who memorized words but cannot speak
- People with no one to practice speaking with
- K-pop / K-drama fans learning Korean (e.g. Japanese learners of Korean)
- Koreans learning English, including students and parents learning together

## Comparisons
- [Speak vs StealthVox (Korean)](https://stealthvox-app.web.app/vs/speak/): curriculum-based drills vs learning from your own words and calls with friends
- [StealthVox vs HelloTalk (English)](https://stealthvox-app.web.app/en/vs/hellotalk/): language-exchange community vs AI speaking practice and AI-interpreted calls with friends you know
- [StealthVox vs HelloTalk (Japanese)](https://stealthvox-app.web.app/ja/vs/hellotalk/)
